mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cors`.`shop_items` (`shop_id`,`item_name`, `color`, `size`, `price`,`style` ,`main_category`, `sub_category`, `detail_category`, `main_image_index`, `created_at`, `updated_at`) VALUES (#{item.shopId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.color}, #{item.size}, #{item.price}, #{item.style}, #{item.mainCategory}, #{item.subCategory}, #{item.detailCategory}, #{item.mainImageIndex}, IFNULL(#{item.createdAt}, NOW()), IFNULL(#{item.updatedAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si WHERE si.`shop_id` = #{shopId} ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC

SELECT `id` AS `id`, `shop_id` AS `shopId`, `item_name` AS `itemName`, `color` AS `color`, `size` AS `size`, `price` AS `price`, `style` AS `style`, `main_category` AS `mainCategory`, `sub_category` AS `subCategory`, `detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, `main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `updated_at` AS `updateAt`, `deleted_at` AS `deletedAt` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` WHERE `id` = #{id} LIMIT 1;

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, /* 아래 서브쿼리가 추가되어야 이미지를 가져옵니다 */ (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si WHERE si.`style` = #{style} ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, img.id AS img_id, -- 이미지 컬럼은 이름 겹치니까 별명 붙이기 img.image_path AS img_path, img.original_name AS img_name FROM `cors`.`shop_items` AS `si` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_item_images` AS `img` ON `si`.id = `img`.product_id WHERE si.id = #{id}

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si WHERE si.`item_name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`main_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`sub_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`detail_category` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.`style` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC
SELECT image_path FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` WHERE product_id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, info.`shop_name` AS `shopName`, /* 요청하신 이미지 서브쿼리 */ (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath`, li.`created_at` AS `createdAt` FROM `cors`.`like_items` li INNER JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON li.`item_id` = si.`id` INNER JOIN `cors`.`shop_info` info ON li.`shop_id` = info.`shop_id` WHERE li.`user_email` = #{userEmail} ORDER BY li.`created_at` DESC

SELECT si.`id` AS `id`, si.`item_name` AS `itemName`, si.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, si.`color` AS `color`, si.`size` AS `size`, si.`price` AS `price`, si.`style` AS `style`, si.`main_category` AS `mainCategory`, si.`sub_category` AS `subCategory`, si.`detail_category` AS `detailCategory`, si.`main_image_index` AS `mainImageIndex`, si.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, si.`updated_at` AS `updateAt`, si.`deleted_at` AS `deletedAt`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`shop_items` si ORDER BY si.`updated_at` DESC LIMIT #{page.rowCount} OFFSET #{page.dbOffset}
